results.trackName: The Old Man and the Sea
results.description:
The Old Man and the Sea is one of Ernest Hemingway’s most beloved works. It tells the story of Santiago, an old fisherman who has gone many days without a catch. Refusing to give up, he sails far from shore and finally hooks a huge marlin.

What begins as a fishing trip becomes a long and difficult struggle between the fisherman, the fish, and the sea. Santiago faces exhaustion, loneliness, and loss, but he continues to fight with patience and determination.

Simple, moving, and quietly powerful, Hemingway’s story is about persistence, pride, courage, and the strength to carry on when things do not go your way. It is a classic that continues to speak to readers of all ages.
